nodes.name: inviteCreate.js
nodes.summary: Discord inviteCreate event handler that records the usage count of a newly created invite in the client's invite tracking map for later join-source attribution.

nodes.name: inviteDelete.js
nodes.summary: Discord inviteDelete event handler that evicts a deleted invite code from the client's cached invite map so join attribution stays accurate.

nodes.name: aiAgentScanner.js
nodes.summary: Multi-agent AI portfolio scanner that fans developer application answers out to three specialized Groq LLM agents in parallel and merges their scores, strengths, red flags, and missing-item feedback into one report.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs a Promise.all fan-out over agent configs and strips markdown code fences before JSON.parse so free-form LLM output becomes machine-readable.

nodes.name: aiReportEmbed.js
nodes.summary: Builds the Discord message-component report for an AI portfolio scan: accent-colored containers with score bars, strengths, missing items, red flags, per-agent lines, and a metadata footer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Discord's newer ContainerBuilder / TextDisplayBuilder / SeparatorBuilder component API instead of the classic EmbedBuilder.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: Shared dark-theme stylesheet for the Express web dashboard covering header and navigation, cards, product grid, badges, buttons, profile stats, admin review items, footer, and a mobile breakpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: Organized into commented section blocks with a single max-width:768px media query that collapses grids and the nav for mobile.

nodes.name: reviews.ejs
nodes.summary: Admin moderation queue template listing pending seller submissions and buyer requests with their answers, AI evaluation scores, admin responses, and accept/decline actions posted to /api/review-action.

nodes.name: dashboard.ejs
nodes.summary: User dashboard template rendering the logged-in member's Discord servers as manage cards, with an Arabic/English language toggle and staggered card entrance animations.

nodes.name: error.ejs
nodes.summary: Minimal standalone error page rendering an optional message passed by the Express error handler plus a link back to the home page.

nodes.name: index.ejs
nodes.summary: Public landing page offering Discord OAuth login and bot invite links, a bot feature list, and a client-side Arabic/English RTL language switcher.
nodes.languageNotes: Renders Arabic right-to-left by default and flips document.dir, lang, and every text node client-side when the language button is pressed.

nodes.name: index.ejs
nodes.summary: Marketplace catalog template filtering and listing Roblox products by category and search text, with a purchase button that posts to /api/purchase-product.

nodes.name: my-products.ejs
nodes.summary: Seller-facing template listing the current user's marketplace products with status badges and a removal action that posts to /api/remove-product.

nodes.name: profile.ejs
nodes.summary: User profile page showing the trust badge, marketplace statistics, recent listings, purchases, and reviews, with a logged-out fallback that links to Discord OAuth.

nodes.name: recaptcha.ejs
nodes.summary: Arabic right-to-left reCAPTCHA challenge page that renders Google's reCAPTCHA widget and submits the form response to /verify-recaptcha.

nodes.name: server-dashboard.ejs
nodes.summary: Per-guild control panel template rendering anti-raid and moderation protection toggles, per-command enable switches, and a marketplace management tab, all wired to CSRF-protected JSON APIs.
nodes.languageNotes: Generates bilingual toggle cards by looping EJS over protection-type arrays and indexing inline Arabic/English lookup maps by key.

nodes.name: verify.ejs
nodes.summary: Account verification page that POSTs the guild ID, user ID, and CSRF token to /verify, then reports success or failure inline with a loading spinner.

nodes.name: buildPortfolioText
nodes.summary: Flattens developer application answers and application metadata into a markdown text block formatted for the LLM agent prompts.

nodes.name: callAgent
nodes.summary: Sends the portfolio text to one configured Groq chat agent, strips markdown fences from the reply, parses the JSON, and returns a normalized result or an error entry.

nodes.name: aggregateResults
nodes.summary: Merges the per-agent results into a single report with an averaged score, classification tally, combined strengths, missing items and red flags, evidence excerpts, and per-category sub-scores.

nodes.name: scanPortfolioWithAI
nodes.summary: Exported entry point that builds the portfolio text, runs every configured AI agent concurrently, and returns the aggregated evaluation report.

nodes.name: buildAIAgentReportEmbed
nodes.summary: Assembles the complete Discord report payload for an AI portfolio scan, chaining containers for the classification header, score bars, strengths, missing items, red flags, per-agent lines, and metadata.

nodes.name: changeLanguage
nodes.summary: Swaps every landing page string between Arabic and English, flips document direction, and replays the entrance animations on the changed elements.

nodes.name: toggleLanguage
nodes.summary: Toggles the dashboard title, action buttons, and empty-state message between Arabic and English and switches the document direction.

nodes.name: toggleCommand
nodes.summary: POSTs a command enable/disable change for a guild to /api/toggle-command together with the CSRF token.

nodes.name: toggleProtection
nodes.summary: POSTs an anti-raid or moderation protection toggle for a guild to /api/toggle-protection together with the CSRF token.

nodes.name: removeProduct
nodes.summary: Confirms with the admin and posts product deletion to /api/remove-product, reloading the control panel when the server reports success.

nodes.name: acceptReview
nodes.summary: Confirms and submits an accept action for a pending review to /api/review-action with the CSRF token, then reloads the queue.

nodes.name: declineReview
nodes.summary: Prompts the admin for a reason and posts the decline action for a pending review to /api/review-action with the CSRF token.

nodes.name: purchaseProduct
nodes.summary: Confirms and submits a product purchase to /api/purchase-product with the CSRF token, reloading the catalog on success.

nodes.name: removeProduct
nodes.summary: Confirms and posts a product removal to /api/remove-product with the CSRF token, reloading the seller's listing grid on success.
